applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric air-to-water (Ecodan) heat pump systems with an FTC controller, one adapter per system.
summary: For air-to-water (Ecodan) systems the MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) serves a large object set on BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP: system on/off, operating mode, DHW and zone setpoints, prohibit and forced-DHW commands, then many read-only analog inputs for temperatures, flow, heat pump frequencies, run hours, error codes, energy produced and consumed, and FTC configuration. Many status values are coded integers in analog inputs rather than binary or multistate objects.
notes: Access is not printed per object; it follows the guide's property table (AV, BO and multistate outputs have a writable present value and priority array; inputs are read-only).
The adapter detects the connected unit type and only serves the matching object list (Air-To-Air, Air-To-Water or Lossnay).
Temperature objects read in °C or °F according to the Temperature Units multistate output.
Several analog inputs carry coded values (0/1 flags, bit-packed DIP switch states, 7-segment error digits); the codes are in the states field where the guide lists them.
Some temperatures are documented as value x10 (e.g. AV 21 outdoor air temperature).

source.title: Procon MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) Installation Manual (manual 1.0.3, firmware 4.1.1)

integration.summary: Select BACnet with DIP switch 7, then write system on/off, the operating mode, DHW tank and zone setpoints, and read flow, return and tank temperatures plus the error objects.

minimum_points.name: ATW Zone1 HC Target Temperature Int

integration.enable: No separate enable; the Setup objects command the FTC directly. Prohibit objects (BO 11-15, AV 8) lock functions at the unit's remote controller.
setup: DIP switch 7 OFF selects BACnet (MS/TP and BACnet IP); ON selects Modbus RTU.
DIP switches 1-5 set the RS-485 node address 1-30 (all OFF = 1, all ON = set in software); it is the MS/TP station ID.
DIP switch 6 ON fixes RS-485 at 9600 baud, no parity; OFF uses the software baud rate (MS/TP up to 76800).
Default IP address 192.168.92.114; network settings are changed on the adapter's web page.
Device instance, Max Master and Max Info Frames are set through Modbus holding registers 272-275.
gotchas: AV 8 (MRC prohibit) is bit-packed and the guide says it must not be written to Shizuoka-designed models.
Zone 2 objects only apply to two-zone systems; slave and refrigerant-address objects only apply to cascaded systems.
